description: Contains command-line interface implementations for microphone management, including listing available input devices and setting the default input device index.

classes.name: MicCommand
classes.description: Main command grouping for microphone-related subcommands.

classes.name: MicList
classes.description: Subcommand to list available microphone input devices.

classes.name: MicSet
classes.description: Subcommand to set the default microphone input device by index and optionally update configuration.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the listing or setting of microphone device based on subcommand.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes command instances, possibly parsing values.
